cause: The scene strip had tabindex=0 but no carousel ownership semantic. The existing panel touch-start guard checks aria-roledescription=carousel, and the global keyboard target guard omitted carousels.
fix: Give the scene strip role=region and aria-roledescription=carousel; recognize the same carousel ownership in the existing keyboard guard. Preserve default native scrolling and restaurant navigation outside that strip.
